title: Liuwei Dihuang pills suppress hepatocellular carcinoma via PI3K/AKT/TP53 pathway: Integrating network pharmacology, metabolomics, and experimental validation.
authors: Cai, Hongxin; Hu, Qi; Song, Zhiying; Nie, Mengyuan; Deng, Yufeng; Huang, Wenxiang; Xin, Fu; Lei, Yongrong; Zhan, Dujuan; Liu, Meng; Ying, Ping; Xie, Baogang
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究六味地黄丸通过PI3K/AKT/TP53通路抑制肝癌，涉及网络药理学、代谢组学和实验验证，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) remains a significant global health challenge with limited treatment options. Liuwei Dihuang Pills (LWPs), a classic Traditional Chinese Medicine formula, have demonstrated potential anti-tumor effects; however, their bioactive components and mechanisms of action against HCC remain unclear. Network pharmacology identified 20 core targets of LWPs, and Gene Ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) analyses indicated pro-apoptotic activity via the PI3K/AKT and TP53 pathways. In vivo studies confirmed tumor growth inhibition, biochemical index regulation, and regulation of the PI3K/AKT/TP53 axis. Metabolomics revealed alterations in amino acid and carbohydrate metabolism. In vitro, LWPs-containing serum (LWPs-S) on the PI3K/AKT/TP53 pathway, suppressing Huh7 cell proliferation, migration, and invasion, inducing G1-phase arrest, elevating reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels, and engaging apoptosis-related pathways. Among various extracts, LWPs alcohol extract emerged as the principal anti-HCC fraction. A total of 77 components were identified in LWPs alcohol extract, including 17 blood‑absorbed and 6 tumor‑absorbed plant monomer compounds. Molecular docking demonstrated strong binding affinities of specific monomers from LWPs alcohol extract to PI3K, AKT and TP53. Collectively, these findings elucidate how LWPs promote HCC apoptosis through key pathways and provide experimental evidence supporting the pivotal role of the alcohol extract, offering a scientific basis for the rational development of LWPs.
abstract_zh: 肝细胞癌（HCC）仍是全球重大健康挑战，治疗选择有限。六味地黄丸（LWPs）作为一种经典中药方剂，已显示出潜在的抗肿瘤作用；然而，其抗HCC的生物活性成分和作用机制仍不清楚。网络药理学鉴定出LWPs的20个核心靶点，基因本体论（GO）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）分析表明其通过PI3K/AKT和TP53通路发挥促凋亡活性。体内研究证实了肿瘤生长抑制、生化指标调节以及PI3K/AKT/TP53轴的调控。代谢组学揭示了氨基酸和碳水化合物代谢的改变。体外实验中，含LWPs血清（LWPs-S）作用于PI3K/AKT/TP53通路，抑制Huh7细胞增殖、迁移和侵袭，诱导G1期阻滞，升高活性氧（ROS）水平，并参与凋亡相关通路。在各种提取物中，LWPs醇提物被确定为主要抗HCC活性部位。在LWPs醇提物中共鉴定出77种成分，包括17种血中吸收和6种肿瘤中吸收的植物单体化合物。分子对接表明，LWPs醇提物中的特定单体与PI3K、AKT和TP53具有强结合亲和力。综上所述，这些发现阐明了LWPs如何通过关键通路促进HCC凋亡，并为醇提物的关键作用提供了实验证据，为LWPs的合理开发提供了科学依据。
